main.sum_values(values: Iterable[float]) → float¶

Compute the sum of a sequence of numbers.

\[S = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i\]
Parameters:

values – an iterable of numbers to sum

Returns:

the total, as a float

Raises:

TypeError – if values contains non-numeric items
